acceptanceCriteria: Production graph injects ProductionScreenDataManager and never EmptyScreenDataManager.
Android and iOS each construct the platform SQL driver and persistent Multiplatform Settings through typed entrypoints.
Exactly one retained AppRootComponent and LifecycleRegistry exist per application graph; lifecycle callbacks are explicit and platform-hostable.
Release and debug store-factory selection obeys AppRootDependencies without enabling debug tooling in release.
iOS MainViewController uses the retained production graph/root and has no no-argument placeholder path.
Previews and tests do not create the production database or graph.
No host files, domain behavior, persistence schema, external projects or product scope changes; specialist does not run Gradle or edit the ledger.
goal: Implement an application-scoped production composition graph for Android and iOS that owns lifecycle, SQLDelight database/settings/data manager/store factories and creates exactly one AppRootComponent; expose typed Android and iOS entrypoints so hosts pass and retain the same root. Keep previews isolated and iOS advertising untouched/safe-disabled.
